name: Fiber Bundle Skeleton Computation
summary: Computes the skeleton (backbone or centreline) of a white matter bundle from a .tck file with a DIPY-based tool and outputs it as a .tck.
description: Runs bundle_skeleton.py: selects the core streamlines of the bundle, resamples them to N_points and averages them into one representative backbone, or optionally returns the streamline closest to it. Use it to get a single centreline for tract profiling or visualisation. Needs a single bundle and a reference T1w image in the same space.

inputs.description: Reference T1-weighted image in the same space as the bundle.

outputs.description: Bundle skeleton (or representative streamline) as track.tck.

parameters.description: Core streamline percentile used to select the bundle core (0 disables).
Keep streamlines longer than length_thr times the maximum length.
Enable density smoothing in core selection.
Number of points used to resample each streamline.
Use endpoint_mode for endpoints and preserve them through smoothing.
Aggregation method for interior points (mean or median).
Endpoint aggregation method when keep_endpoints is enabled.
Output the streamline closest to the backbone instead of the backbone.
Apply spline smoothing to the backbone.

citations.text: Amorosino G, Olivetti E, Jovicich J, Avesani P. How Does White Matter Registration Affect Tractography Alignment? IEEE ISBI (2023).
Garyfallidis E, et al. Dipy, a library for the analysis of diffusion MRI data. Front Neuroinform 8:8 (2014).
